announcement.title: Clearer agent status and more reliable sessions
announcement.description:
Halofy 445 shows actual agent activity and concise reasons for failed turns. Resolved task connection errors disappear when host and client are updated, and agreeing budget checks arriving out of order no longer interrupt work. Protected Antigravity conversations retry temporary provider errors within a bounded retry budget and stop clearly if the model is never reached. Sign-in validation keeps private details out of errors.

Mobile 1.4.17 keeps healthy connections through brief app switches and simplifies Agents status text. Android 1.4.17 (build 20) now updates the original .444 app with the same signing key. Install over the existing app; do not uninstall or clear data. The earlier different-key APK is withdrawn. See the release notes for the verified update download. The iOS download is for Apple Silicon Simulator only.

Windows installers remain unsigned. Protected Claude cleanup on Windows and affected Ubuntu Cloud PC snapshot capture remain under investigation. Some mobile controls can clip at the largest accessibility text size. Add to Chrome remains disabled until the Chrome Web Store listing is updated.
